item.title: 👉 Andrei Belousov inspects facilities of Russian Defence Ministry in Kyrgyzstan In the framework of his visit to Kyrgyzstan, Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov
item.description: Andrei Belousov inspects facilities of Russian Defence Ministry in Kyrgyzstan 👉 In the framework of his visit to Kyrgyzstan, Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov inspected facilities of the testing base located on Lake Issyk-Kul. ✅ The Minister checked the state of the base equipment , which includes boats and vessels of various projects prepared for testing. ➡️ The head of the testing base reported to the Russian Defence Minister that the main task of the base is to conduct serial tests of anti-submarine weapons of the Russian Navy as well as systems of defence against torpedoes mounted on surface ships and submarines. 🎮 Modern unmanned aerial vehicles enabled to carry out real-time control and surveillance tests. 📍 The base is a unique Russian military facility located at an altitude of 1,609 metres above mean sea level. Lake Issyk-Kul remains unfrozen all year round and its water is close to sea. It is ideal for testing sea weapons and diving gear. 💬 At the end of the inspection, the Russian Defence Minister held a meeting with the base command . He heard a report on current and future tasks, the progress of weapons testing, and development of infrastructure. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ➡️ Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov arrives on working visit to Cholpon-Ata in Kyrgyz Republic. There, meeting of Council of Ministers of Defence of the CIS will take place
item.description: Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov arrives on working visit to Cholpon-Ata in Kyrgyz Republic. There, meeting of Council of Ministers of Defence of the CIS will take place. ➡️ The event is to be visited by delegations from Azerbaijan, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Russia, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan as well as representatives of Council of Ministers of Defence of the CIS Secretariat. 📑 It is planned to discuss topical issues of the development of military cooperation in the CIS as well as to agree on joint activities of the CIS armed forces in 2027. 🤝 On the sidelines of the event, the Russian Defence Minister will have bilateral meetings with heads of delegations of defence ministries of the CIS member states. 📍 Moreover, Andrei Belousov will visit Russian military bases located in the Republic. The CIS Defence Ministers Council meets in follow-up to the agreements reached within the framework of the CIS Summit with the participation of President of the Russian Federation Vladimir Putin. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ➡️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. ➡️ Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region tighten the encirclement and expand the external control zone. 💥 Fights are underway in the encirclement for the liberation of Nikolayevka and Varvarovka (Kharkov region). ▪️ The AFU surrounded task force has lost up to 40 troops during the day. ▫️ While extending the external control zone, Russian units operate to seize Prikolotnoye, Kotovka, and Gogino (Kharkov region). 💥 Manpower and hardware of a heavy mechanised brigade, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a detachment of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine have been hit near Kurgannoye, Fedorovka, Maly Burluk, and Khatneye (Kharkov region). 🔥 In Kharkov region , manpower and hardware of two motorised infantry brigades and an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit close to Rubezhnoye, Velikiye Prokhody, Bugayevka, Izbitskoye, and Velikiy Burluk (Kharkov region). 📍 In Sumy region , strikes were delivered at formations of a mechanised brigade, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades close to Velikaya Rybitsa, Nikolskoye, Barilovka, Kucherovka, Glukhov (Sumy region), and the city of Sumy. ▪️ In total, more than 225 troops, 17 motor vehicles, one Grad MLRS and four electronic warfare stations have been neutralised by the enemy in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces. 📍 The Zapad Group's unit
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30033

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
➡️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region tighten the encirclement
and expand the external control zone.
💥
Fights are underway
in the encirclement
for the liberation of Nikolayevka and Varvarovka
(Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU surrounded task force has lost up to 40 troops during the day.
▫️
While extending the external control zone, Russian units operate
to seize Prikolotnoye, Kotovka, and Gogino (Kharkov region).
💥
Manpower and hardware
of a heavy mechanised brigade, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a detachment of the State Border Guard Service of Ukraine have been hit near Kurgannoye, Fedorovka, Maly Burluk, and Khatneye (Kharkov region).
🔥
In Kharkov region
, manpower and hardware of two motorised infantry brigades and an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit close to Rubezhnoye, Velikiye Prokhody, Bugayevka, Izbitskoye, and Velikiy Burluk (Kharkov region).
📍
In Sumy region
, strikes were delivered at formations of a mechanised brigade, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades close to Velikaya Rybitsa, Nikolskoye, Barilovka, Kucherovka, Glukhov (Sumy region), and the city of Sumy.
▪️
In total, more than 225 troops, 17 motor vehicles, one Grad MLRS and four electronic warfare stations have been neutralised by the enemy in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
The Zapad Group's units improved the situation along the front line
and inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, an assault brigade of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades close to Tamarganovka, Blagodatovka, Maliyevka, Osinovo (Kharkov region), Bogorodichnoye, and Volchiy Yar in the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 240 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, 23 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and two electronic warfare stations.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions
. Strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, a mountain assault brigade, an airmobile brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a marine brigade close to Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Vysokoivanovka, Semenovka, and Nikolayevka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 155 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 33 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 14 October 2026
item.description: 🎖 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 14 October 2026 Part 2 ( 👉 see Part 1 ) 💥 The Tsentr Group of Forces inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an airborne brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, and two national guard brigades close to Starovarvarovka, Verovka, Belozerskoye, Svyatogorovka, Veselaya Gora, Shilovka, Novoyavlenka (Donetsk People's Republic), and Krutoyarovka (Dnepropetrovsk region). ▫️ Near Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic), assault groups of the 51st Army advanced in the central and northern-western parts of the city. Assault detachments of marines units continued the offensive in the western part of the settlement. 📊 Over the past 24 hours, 142 buildings have been liberated, up to 25 servicemen have been neutralised. ▪️ In total, up to 350 troops, one armoured personnel carrier, five armoured fighting vehicles, 14 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and two electronic warfare stations have been neutralised in the area of responsibility of the Tsentr Group of Forces. ↗️ The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence . Manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, two air assault brigades, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and two marine brigades have been hit close to Tarasovka, Kolomiytsy, Chernenkovo (Dnepropetrovsk region), Rayskoye, Mirolyubovka, Barvinovka, Omelnik, and Volnyanka (Zaporozhye region).

💥
The Tsentr Group of Forces inflicted losses
on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an airborne brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, a marine brigade, and two national guard brigades close to Starovarvarovka, Verovka, Belozerskoye, Svyatogorovka, Veselaya Gora, Shilovka, Novoyavlenka (Donetsk People's Republic), and Krutoyarovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▫️
Near Dobropolye
(Donetsk People's Republic), assault groups of the 51st Army advanced in the central and northern-western parts of the city. Assault detachments of marines units continued the offensive in the western part of the settlement.
📊
Over the past 24 hours, 142 buildings have been liberated, up to 25 servicemen have been neutralised.
▪️
In total, up to 350 troops, one armoured personnel carrier, five armoured fighting vehicles, 14 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and two electronic warfare stations have been neutralised in the area of responsibility of the Tsentr Group of Forces.
↗️
The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence
. Manpower and hardware of a mechanised brigade, two air assault brigades, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and two marine brigades have been hit close to Tarasovka, Kolomiytsy, Chernenkovo (Dnepropetrovsk region), Rayskoye, Mirolyubovka, Barvinovka, Omelnik, and Volnyanka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 265 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions
. Russian troops hit formations of two mechanised brigades and a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine near Orekhov and Kushugum (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 30 troops, 18 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and three electronic warfare stations were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack unmanned aerial vehicles, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces
have inflicted damage on drone manufacturing shops, storage areas of long-range unmanned aerial vehicles as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations in 146 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
1,425 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.

item.title: 👊 Firsthand details of the assault Servicemen of the 344th Motorised Rifle Regiment (Sever Group of Forces)
item.description: Firsthand details of the assault 👊 Servicemen of the 344th Motorised Rifle Regiment (Sever Group of Forces) are breaking resistance of Ukrainian nationalists in Kharkov region. 💬 The battalion commander with the call sign 'Spartak' told about the liberation of Lukashovo and Reznikovo : 'These two settlements are next to each other, connected by a road. Small assault groups moved along treelines, through treelines, and wiped out the fortifications there. Lukashovo became our bridgehead for advance on Reznikovo.' 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
